title: vivo V80 and X Fold6 are now on sale in India
description: The vivo V80 and X Fold6, launched in India last week, are now on sale through vivo's Indian website, Amazon.in, Flipkart, and partner retail stores. The vivo V80 comes in Sunrise Anthem, Horizon Blue, and Stellar Black colors. All have three memory options - 8GB/128GB, 8GB/256GB, and 8GB/512GB, priced at INR62,999, INR69,999, and INR79,999, respectively. vivo V80's color options The vivo X Fold6, on the other hand, comes in Nebula Teal and Prism Black in one memory configuration, 12GB/512GB, priced at INR219,999. title: Honor Win2 and Win2 RT complete design and colors revealed, Win Turbo2 will tag along
description: After recently teasing the phones’ rear panel, Honor has now confirmed that the Win 2 series will include a Win Turbo 2 variant. Honor also revealed their complete designs, colors, and configurations. The lineup is set to launch in China on October 21. The Honor Win2 will get an active cooling fan, a dual-rear camera setup, and will be available in Red and Blue Buff, Black, and White color options. title: Samsung and Apple were the winners in a Q3 smartphone market that dropped 20%
description: Counterpoint Research (CR) has just published its report regarding the global smartphone market for the third quarter of the year (July to September). And it was a terrible one. Shipments dropped 20% compared to Q3 2025. The only winners in terms of growing their market shares were Samsung and Apple. Samsung led the pack with a 23% market share (compared to 19% in the year-ago quarter), while Apple was a close second with 22% (up from 18% in Q3 2025). They were followed by Xiaomi with 10% of the pie (down from 14%), Oppo with 9% (down from 12%), and vivo with 8% (down from 9%). CR...

title: Google's new Fitbit Edge fitness tracker offers a screen and up to 7 days of usage
description: Google has unveiled its latest fitness tracker, the Fitbit Edge. Positioned between the Pixel Watch 5 and the Fitbit Air, the new tracker offers a more affordable and lighter alternative to the smartwatch while adding a display over the screenless Fitbit Air. The Fitbit Edge sports a 1.34-inch AMOLED display with always-on functionality. The tracker measures 11.5mm in thickness and features an aluminum case that weighs 17.7 grams without the band. A physical button on the right side of the case lets users navigate the interface. Unlike the Pixel Watch 5, the Fitbit Edge does not run...

title: Main specs leak for Oppo's upcoming wide Reno X
description: For a while now, Oppo has been rumored to be working on a wide candybar smartphone, a genre reinvented by the Huawei Pura X View recently. According to past leaks, Oppo's entrant into this space will be called Reno X. Today, a tipster on X has purportedly shared its main specs. The device allegedly has a 6.35-inch flat screen with a 120Hz refresh rate and a 16:9 or 16:10 aspect ratio (for reference, note that the Pura X View has a 5:3 aspect ratio, which sits in between 16:9 and 16:10). title: WhatsApp starts testing scheduled messages
description: WhatsApp has allegedly spent months developing a feature that will let you schedule messages, and this is now finally being made available to a limited number of users who are part of the beta program for WhatsApp on the Google Play Store for Android. As you might expect, it lets you schedule messages to be delivered at a specific date and time. It works both for one-on-one chats and group chats. description: Google unveiled the Fitbit Edge today, but it also announced an update for the Fitbit Air. Namely, it revealed that it's making available two new Metal Mesh bands for the screen-less fitness tracker. title: JP Morgan: demand for iPhone 18 Pro models is stronger than for the 17 Pro models last year
description: Analysts are sending mixed signals – sales of the iPhone 18 Pro models in China are stronger than those of the 17 Pro models and yet Apple is reportedly cutting component orders due to weak demand. The analysts at JP Morgan are saying that there’s nothing to worry about. In a note to investors, the analysts say that the production cut is a fairly typical adjustment for Apple after a big iPhone launch. They blame it on the split launch – Apple launched the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max in September and will launch the non-Pro models early next year. The note from JP Morgan confirms...

title: One UI 9 for the Galaxy S24 series, Galaxy Z Fold6 and Flip6 reaches the US
description: Last week, Samsung's One UI 9 rollout reached the Galaxy S24 series as well as the Galaxy Z Fold6 and Flip6, but, as usual, the company started it in South Korea. Now, a few days later, the update is also available in the US. Galaxy S24 devices purchased from both AT&T and T-Mobile are starting to receive the update in the US. The update comes over-the-air as an almost 4GB download, so make sure you grab it over a fast enough network. title: Huawei may be launching a new phone sub-brand, here is what it will be called
description: When Huawei was put under trade restrictions by the US, it was no longer able to use Android for its phones – at least not the version offered by Google. Eventually, the company settled on a split strategy – Huawei proper would focus on its in-house HarmonyOS and Kirin chipsets while the Honor sub-brand would be spun off and continue with Android (and it retained access to Qualcomm and MediaTek chips). title: iQOO Neo12's key specifications officially revealed
description: A recent rumor claimed that iQOO’s upcoming Neo12 would feature a 2K resolution display with a 185Hz refresh rate, supplied by Chinese manufacturer Visionox. Now, iQOO has officially confirmed the display specs and revealed a few more key details about the phone. The iQOO Neo12 is set to launch in China this month, although the company has yet to announce an exact date. Ahead of the launch, iQOO has confirmed that the phone will feature an OLED panel from Visionox. The display will offer a 2K resolution and 185Hz refresh rate. title: OnePlus 16 arrives with SD 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6, 200MP camera and 9,000 mAh battery
description: The OnePlus 16 is now official, and it's shaping up to be one of the most interesting phones exclusive to China. It brings all of the upgrades you’d expect, including the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chip, a 200MP main cam and a healthy battery upgrade. Regarding the latter, the phone can run at 165Hz in everyday tasks while the extra 20Hz is “unlocked” in supported gaming titles. title: Nothing launches CMF Speakers S&M, here are the specs and pricing details
description: As expected from its teaser last week, Nothing's CMF has launched a couple of new products today. Meet the CMF Speakers S&M. These are the first portable speakers from CMF, and they both come with an "expressive geometric design", Bluetooth 6.0, IP68 dust and water resistance, as well as Stereo Mode and Party Mode for multi-speaker listening. Stereo Mode requires two identical speakers, while Party Mode is basically Auracast by a different name so it can work with two or more compatible speakers, including those from other brands.
